endorsements.name: Yeting Li
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-28493
endorsements.description: This affects the package jinja2 from 0.0.0 and before 2.11.3. The ReDoS vulnerability is mainly due to the `_punctuation_re regex` operator and its use of multiple wildcards. The last wildcard is the most exploitable as it searches for trailing punctuation. This issue can be mitigated by Markdown to format user content instead of the urlize filter, or by implementing request timeouts and limiting process memory.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.3)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.label: CVE-2020-28496
endorsements.description: This affects the package three before 0.125.0. This can happen when handling rgb or hsl colors.
